title: THE SATURDAY ATLAS
dek: Every Division I football program. One honest place to begin.
body:
College football usually arranges schools as a top 25 and lets the rest of the country disappear. The Saturday Atlas keeps the useful electricity of a ranking, then refuses to turn the whole field into a fake score.

The 2026–27 NCAA directory resolves to 266 Division I football programs: 138 FBS and 128 FCS. The current PointCast 25 appears first in exact Board 000 order. The remaining programs become browse order—FBS A–Z, then FCS A–Z—not a national quality ranking.

For students, every record opens the institution before the football program. Search by school, conference, state, subdivision, public/private status, or HBCU status. Sort the field. Keep a shortlist on one device. Then ask about tickets, transit, the walk home, the other six days, aid, housing, accessibility, student life, and what the institution chooses to build around Saturday.

Football is one room. A student lives in the whole house.
